texte.Nommer précisément le système et son usa: Name the system and its actual use precisely — not the vendor’s product, but the concrete business use.
texte.Nommez un responsable pour chaque docume: Name an owner for each document and date its last review. Export the tracking as a PDF before an audit or an inspection.
texte.Non pas une relecture : une signature —: Not a re-read: a signature — someone named, who can be questioned two years from now.
texte.Non renseigné — à trancher avant tout dé: Not provided — to be decided before any deployment.
texte.Notation automatisee des collaborateurs: Automated rating of employees influencing promotion or dismissal.
texte.Notez aussi ce que vous avez REFUSÉ de m: Also note what you REFUSED to place on the market: it is the most convincing evidence that the diligence is real.
texte.Notez chaque axe de # (très faible) à #: Score each axis from # (very low) to # (very high). The weighted overall score, the priority and the positioning are calculated in real time. Weightings: impact # %, feasibility # %, data # %, controlled risk # %.
texte.Notez chaque pilier de gouvernance et do: Score each governance pillar and document the justifications for each score.
texte.Notez dès maintenant s’il existe une sol: Note now whether an identified fallback solution exists: this information cannot be reconstructed in an emergency.
texte.Notez le stade atteint : POC, pilote, pr: Note the stage reached: POC, pilot, production, abandoned. It is the only feasibility indicator that does not come from a supplier.
texte.Notice d'utilisation accompagnant le sys: Instructions for use accompanying the system: identity of the provider, capabilities and limitations, level of performance, required input data, residual risks, recommended human oversight measures.
texte.Notice d’utilisation complete fournie au: Complete instructions for use provided to the deployer (Art. #(#))
texte.Notification a la Commission europeenne: Notification to the European Commission if systemic risk (Art. #(#)(b))
texte.Notification initiale sous #h après déte: Initial notification within #h of detecting a significant incident, intermediate report within #h, final report within # month.
texte.Notification initiale à l'autorité compé: Initial notification to the competent authority within #h of classifying a major ICT-related incident, intermediate report within #h, final report within # month — including incidents affecting AI systems in the ICT infrastructure.
texte.Notification à l'ENISA des vulnérabilité: Notification to ENISA of actively exploited vulnerabilities within #h, full report within #h, final report within # days. Applicable from # September #.
texte.Notification à l'autorité de surveillanc: Notification to the market surveillance authority: fifteen days, reduced to ten in the event of death and to two in the event of a widespread incident.
texte.Notifier l'autorité de surveillance du m: Notify the market surveillance authority of the outcome of the analysis
texte.Notifier la Commission dans les # semain: Notify the Commission within # weeks if the threshold is reached
texte.Notifier sous # jours (défaut), # jours: Notify within # days (default), # days (widespread infringement) or # days (death), as the case may be
texte.Nécessaire à la conclusion ou à l'exécut: Necessary for the conclusion or performance of a contract
texte.N’écrivez ni neutralité ni émissions évi: Claim neither neutrality nor avoided emissions: European regulation on environmental claims is watching closely.
texte.OWASP LLM Top # et MITRE ATLAS pour le p: OWASP LLM Top # and MITRE ATLAS for the vulnerability profile
texte.OWASP LLM — je vérifie qu’aucune défaill: OWASP LLM — I check that no obvious failure mode has been missed
texte.OWASP LLM ↔ ISO/IEC # — ce que la certif: OWASP LLM ↔ ISO/IEC # — what certification does not give you
texte.OWASP Top # pour les applications LLM —: OWASP Top # for LLM Applications — # edition
texte.OWASP dit ce qui casse ; le règlement di: OWASP says what breaks; the Regulation says what is enforceable. Neither can be deduced from the other.
texte.Objective un sujet souvent évalué de faç: Brings objectivity to a subject often assessed optimistically in-house without an external reading grid.
texte.Obligation d'information des citoyens su: Duty to inform citizens about the use of AI. Publication of impact assessments. Explainability of administrative decisions.
texte.Obligation d'informer les personnes de l: Duty to inform individuals of the existence of automated processing, its underlying logic and its foreseeable consequences.
texte.Obligation d'informer les personnes qu'e: Duty to inform people that they are interacting with an AI, marking of generated content.
texte.Obligation de maintenir un contrôle huma: Obligation to maintain effective human oversight over the decisions or actions of the AI system.
texte.Obligation de produire et conserver une: Obligation to produce and keep detailed technical documentation of the system.
texte.Obligations GPAI à risque systémique: Obligations for GPAI with systemic risk
texte.Obstacle à un droit, à un service ou à u: Obstacle to a right, a service or a contract
texte.On ne peut pas être déployeur conforme d: You cannot be a compliant deployer of a system you do not know about. It is the first step, and the one that is almost always skipped.
texte.On peut être parfaitement conforme sur u: You can be perfectly compliant on a tool nobody opens — and heavily used without being compliant. One of the two measurements says nothing about the other.
texte.Onze décisions à prendre, chacune motivé: Eleven decisions to make, each one reasoned, each one with its status. It is half a day, not a project.
texte.OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral via API intég: OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral via API integrated into a product or service
texte.Optimisation automatique des couts cloud: Automatic optimisation of cloud costs (AI FinOps)
texte.Optimisation de l empreinte carbone des: Optimisation of the carbon footprint of journeys
texte.Optimisation du trading sur les marches: Optimisation of trading on energy markets
texte.Ordonnez les chantiers issus de la prior: Order the workstreams resulting from the prioritisation.
texte.Organisez la surveillance du fonctionnem: Organise the monitoring of operation on the basis of the instructions for use (Article #(#)) and the retention of automatically generated logs, for at least six months (Article #(#)).
texte.Orientation automatique des tickets vers: Automatic routing of tickets to the right department or agent.
texte.Orientation immédiate ; charge de tri du: Immediate routing; the department’s triage workload is divided.
texte.Ou deployer avec moins de contraintes ?: Where to deploy with fewer constraints?
texte.Oui si basé sur un modèle GPAI (GPT-#, C: Yes if based on a GPAI model (GPT-#, Claude, Gemini…) — Art. # obligations apply to the provider
texte.Oui — Annexe III point #(a-d) : accès à: Yes — Annex III, point #(a-d): access to education, evaluation of learning outcomes, monitoring of tests
texte.Oui — Annexe III point #(b) : systèmes d: Yes — Annex III, point #(b): systems for allocating tasks or evaluating the behaviour of workers
texte.Oui — Annexe III point #(b) et #(c) : év: Yes — Annex III, points #(b) and #(c): creditworthiness assessment and health insurance pricing
texte.Oui — Annexe III point #(d) : systèmes d: Yes — Annex III, point #(d): systems for evaluating and classifying emergency calls and for triage
texte.Oui — dès qu'il y a interaction directe: Yes — as soon as there is direct interaction with a natural person
texte.Oui — déployeur du modèle, potentielleme: Yes — deployer of the model, potentially provider of the final product
texte.Oui — l'entreprise devient fournisseur d: Yes — the company becomes a de facto provider as soon as it hosts under its own name
texte.Oui — obligation de marquage, distincte: Yes — marking obligation, distinct from the information obligation
texte.Oui, largement, et ce n’est pas suffisan: Yes, largely, and it is not enough. Almost all of the ten measures of Article #(#) find a counterpart in Annex A: a certified system is the most direct evidence base an entity can present. But three things fall completely outside the standard.
texte.Oui, voire interdit selon l'usage — Anne: Yes, or even prohibited depending on the use — Annex III, point # + Art. # for certain uses
texte.Outillage technique de conformité ; ne c: Technical compliance tooling; does not constitute legal advice.
texte.Ouvrez la carte NIST AI RMF : elle porte: Open the NIST AI RMF map: it now carries your profile.
texte.Ouvrez la carte OWASP LLM : elle porte m: Open the OWASP LLM map: it now carries what you have just declared.
texte.Ouvrez la carte des quarante-six juridic: Open the map of the forty-six jurisdictions analysed against twelve criteria, sorted by severity.
texte.Ouvrez la déclaration et traitez les mes: Open the statement and treat the controls named by rank # of the plan.
texte.Ouvrez les deux cartes NIST #-# et #-# :: Open the two NIST #-# and #-# maps: they now carry your declarations.
texte.Ouvrez les formations : leur progression: Open the training: its progress is calculated from your audit scores per pillar, not from a generic catalogue.
texte.Ouvrez l’audit structuré en cinq étapes: Open the audit structured in five steps and apply it to the scope you have just classified.
texte.Ouvrez-la en début de séance : « Actions: Open it at the start of a session: “Priority actions” says what is awaiting a decision from you, “Recent activity” what has moved since your last visit. Close it when the action list is empty.
texte.Ouvrez-la quand un module se vide sans r: Open it when a module empties for no reason: register without systems, audit without checkpoints, analyses without history. Nine times out of ten the session has expired, and this page will tell you so instead of letting you conclude that your data has disappeared.
texte.Ouvrir cette page et avancer le parcours: Open this page and move the path forward by one step.
texte.Ouvrir la page de connexion pour entrer: Open the sign-in page to sign in with another account
texte.Ouvrir le guide d’utilisation de cette p: Open the user guide for this page
texte.Où chaque champ se saisit, et lesquels S: Where each field is entered, and which ones Sentinel has already obtained
texte.Où en sont ceux à qui vous vendez: Where the people you sell to stand
texte.Où le matériel de formation se range: Where the training material is stored
texte.Où vous en êtes sur chacune des neuf, et: Where you stand on each of the nine, and which ones are STOPPED by a blocker rather than simply behind.
texte.PDF officiel fourni par le client (EU_IA: Official PDF provided by the client (EU_IA_ACT.pdf). Articles transcribed and explained in plain language by CONSEILPREV.
texte.PDF officiel fourni par le client, extra: Official PDF provided by the client, extracted via pdftotext. Articles covered by the engine: #, #, #, #, #, #, # to #, #, #, #, #, #, #.
texte.Panel de # cas d’IA documentés, version: Panel of # documented AI cases, version #-#-b — company announcements, authority decisions, specialist press
texte.Panorama des systèmes déployés dans l’UE: Overview of the systems deployed in the EU
texte.Par le haut. L'ordre n'est pas un classe: From the top. The order is not a ranking of difficulty, it is the order in which the actions make each other pay off.
texte.Par où commencer : les angles morts: Where to start: the blind spots
texte.Par rôle au sens du règlement: By role within the meaning of the Regulation
texte.Parce que c’est celle que la surcharge i: Because it is the one that the SP #-# Rev. # industrial overlay tailors — its Appendix G says so. Revision # is the current version: it adds the PT and SR families and renames CA. A system already aligned with revision # therefore reads this rate against an edition older than its own, and the screen reminds you of this before the first figure.
texte.Parcourez le fond de carte « intensité c: Browse the “grid carbon intensity” base map and the footprint table by country, item by item.
texte.Parcourez le panel des cas documentés —: Browse the panel of documented cases — POCs, pilots, production, abandonments — and their AI Act risk classes.
texte.Parcourez le référentiel avec la questio: Browse the framework with the reporting question in mind: which data is defensible, which is an order of magnitude.
texte.Parcourez les # étapes : ciblez votre se: Go through the # steps: target your sector and your processes, select the use cases with potential, qualify them, quantify the expected return and assess your maturity.
texte.Parcourez les # étapes : secteur et proc: Go through the # steps: sector and processes, use cases with potential, qualification, expected return, maturity. Start from the bottlenecks reported by the business, not from the technologies available.
texte.Parcourez les centres de données et les: Browse the data centres and the AI systems actually recorded: country, size, stages reached.
texte.Parcourez les points de contrôle en marq: Go through the checkpoints, marking each one compliant, in progress or to be addressed.
texte.Parcours chiffré — ce que le règlement c: Costed path — what the Regulation puts its own figures on
texte.Parcours guidé en six temps pour identif: A guided path in six stages to identify, qualify, prioritise and then redesign processes around high-business-impact AI use cases, geared to industrial organisations. It is the upstream step: business value before compliance.
texte.Part du nombre d’entités servies, dans: Share of the number of entities served, in
texte.Partez d’une exigence à justifier (un ar: Start from a requirement to be justified (an article, a chapter of a standard) and trace it back to the module that produces the evidence. Conversely, start from a module to find out what it allows you to put forward.
texte.Particulièrement critique si vous entraî: Particularly critical if you train or fine-tune models in-house.
texte.Partiellement — obligation de transparen: Partially — transparency obligation on personalisation (Art. #(#)). Manipulation practices: prohibited (Art. #(#)(a-b)).
texte.Pas d'obligation directe AI Act, mais ri: No direct AI Act obligation, but a knock-on risk of non-compliance (unmarked content, undocumented bias).
texte.Passez du référentiel à VOTRE périmètre: Move from the framework to YOUR scope: enter your equipment and your uses to obtain your own footprint.
texte.Passez d’abord l’Audit IA Act en autonom: First take the AI Act audit on your own (# checkpoints): it brings your obvious gaps to the surface. The assisted audit is all the more valuable when it starts from a finding already established.
texte.Passez en revue les # points de contrôle: Review the # checkpoints, marking each one compliant / in progress / to be addressed.
texte.Passez la check-list sur un projet en co: Run the checklist on a project still being designed, not on a system already delivered. Export it as a PDF to attach it to the project file: it is evidence of accountability.
texte.Passez les # points de contrôle : gestio: Go through the # checkpoints: risk management, data governance, technical documentation, logging, transparency, human oversight, accuracy and robustness, quality management system.
texte.Passez l’audit de maturité et retenez le: Take the maturity audit and note the lowest pillars — data, security, industrialisation.
texte.Passez l’audit de maturité sur les pilie: Take the maturity audit on the skills, governance and organisation pillars, for the scope concerned and not for the whole company.
texte.Passez l’audit sur les piliers données,: Take the audit on the data, skills, infrastructure and organisation pillars, selecting your section of activity.
texte.Personnes formées, disposant du temps, d: People who are trained and have the time, authority and support needed to interrupt or override an output of the system.
texte.Personnes habilitées aux traitements: People authorised to access the processing
texte.Pertinence et representativite verifiees: Relevance and representativeness of the datasets verified (Art. #(#))
texte.Pertinent surtout si votre entreprise op: Relevant mainly if your company operates or plans to expand outside the EU.
texte.Peser le parc de systèmes d’IA que vous: Weigh the estate of AI systems you have already declared in the register: electricity, emissions, primary energy and water, then the trajectories to the horizon. The same declared volume serves FinOps and the footprint — divided by a rate on one side, multiplied by watt-hours on the other. That is why there is only one inventory.
texte.Pilotage automatique de la production so: Automatic steering of solar/wind production according to weather and demand.
texte.Pilote du SMIA — je monte le système de: AIMS lead — I set up the AI management system
texte.Piloter l’empreinte réelle d’un parc de: Steer the actual footprint of an estate of data centres: electricity, CO₂e, amortised manufacturing and cooling water, without confusing what is published with what is calculated.
texte.Pièces à communiquer, référentiel des do: Documents to be disclosed, reference list of the data to be masked.
texte.Plan d action en # phases (même méthodol: Action plan in # phases (same methodology as the maturity audit), with progress calculated from your actual AI register and AI Act audit — not fixed figures.
